mentions.name: Saigon Safe
mentions.description: Fork of Bitwarden's Chrome and Firefox browser extensions (password manager) with UX improvements to make the tool usable, including a feature to handle passwords under duress. The Firefox version is released as the Saigon Safe add-on; the Chrome version is still in progress.
mentions.problem: Bitwarden's official browser extensions have UX that makes the password manager hard to use.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Fork of Bitwarden's Chrome and Firefox extensions (password manager) with UX improvements to make the tool useable.

The coolest feature I added was a tool to handle passwords under duress.
